summary: Iteration 66: validated Point 4 (manual bot pause/resume toggle in ticket header + POST /crm/tickets/{id}/bot-pause) and Point 2 (transient-error retry in add_message_to_ticket). Backend: 8/8 new tests pass (tests/test_iteration_66.py) covering pause/resume persistence, refetch, 404, auth, and the retry loop (transient retry -> success on attempt 2, 3-attempt exhaustion, non-transient fail-fast, healthy first-attempt, httpx ConnectError retry) with httpx.AsyncClient monkeypatched in-process. Regression suites test_bot_pause_api.py + test_manual_message_dedup_and_transfer.py: 12/12 pass. Frontend E2E on preview: login /crmtest/login -> ticket header shows green 'Pausar bot', window.confirm text correct, POST succeeds, toast 'Bot pausado.', header flips to amber 'Reativar bot' in ~1.2s, toggles back to 'Pausar bot', and button is absent (count 0) on a closed whatsapp ticket. No duplicate messages observed in retry paths (exactly 1 message doc, delivery_status=sent, wa_message_id from res.message_id).

integration_issues.issue: BotToggleButton onChanged calls loadData() which only refreshes the ticket LIST, not selectedTicket. The header pill only flips because of the 4s ticket polling (observed ~1.2s in practice). Cleaner: onChanged should call crmAPI.getTicket(selectedTicket.id) and setSelectedTicket(r.data) for instant feedback.

issues: Toast 'Empresa nao encontrada' fires on the tenant login page for company CRM Test (doc has subdomain=crmtest but no slug field) even though login itself works — public company lookup likely queries only `slug`. Pre-existing, unrelated to this iteration, but visible to users.

action_items: Optional polish: make BotToggleButton onChanged refetch the selected ticket instead of relying on the 4s poll.
Optional: tenant login lookup should match `subdomain` as well as `slug` to avoid the 'Empresa nao encontrada' toast on /crmtest/login.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/crm_routes.py add_message_to_ticket is very long and now embeds the retry loop inline; extract the WA send+retry into a helper (e.g. wa_dispatcher.send_with_retry) shared with send_media_to_ticket to avoid drift.

TRANSIENT_HINTS includes the broad token 'timeout'; a permanent upstream error message containing 'timeout' will consume 3 attempts (~3s added latency) on a blocking request. Acceptable, but consider capping total wall time.
Retry loop sleeps 1.5s inside a synchronous HTTP request handler; worst case the POST /messages call takes ~63s (3x30s httpx timeout + 3s sleep). Consider lowering per-attempt timeout for retries.
